name: Wind Chimes With Glass Ornament And Crystal Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality crystal glass ornament with smooth, polished edges and a clear, elegant finish.
    - Glass thickness: 6mm, durable and resistant to fading while maintaining excellent clarity.
    - Wind chime structure includes:
              +)  Wooden top base for stability and aesthetic appeal.
              +)  Aluminum tubes that produce soft and relaxing chime sounds.
              +)  Nylon hanging strings are designed for durability and outdoor use.
              +)  Crystal charm (round or heart shape) that reflects sunlight beautifully.
              +)  Glass ornament printed with personalized artwork or text.
    - Carefully assembled components ensure both visual elegance and soothing sound quality.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Glass Ornament:
              +)  Round: 7.8 cm ~3.07 in.
              +)  Heart: 8.07 cm ~3.18 in.
    - Total hanging length of wind chime: 58 cm
    - Diameter of top wooden base: 10.5 cm
    - Crystal charm size: 3 cm
    - Diameter of each metal tube: 1.5 cm.
    📌 Note: The glass ornament dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Advanced UV printing technology ensures sharp details and vibrant colors.
    - Supports 1-sided or 2-sided printing depending on the selected option.
    - For double-sided printing, the back side is mirrored so the design appears correctly when viewed from both directions.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Decorative wind chime ornament that produces calming sounds when moved by the wind.
    - Ideal for decorating gardens, patios, balconies, windows, porches, or indoor living spaces.
    - The crystal charm captures sunlight and creates beautiful sparkling reflections.
    - Combines visual decoration and relaxing ambient sound, enhancing the atmosphere of any space.
    - Lightweight and easy to hang, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor décor.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful gift for family members, friends, or loved ones.
    - Perfect for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, memorial gifts, or housewarming occasions.
    - Ideal for those who appreciate personalized keepsakes and relaxing home décor.
    - A beautiful combination of personalization, craftsmanship, and soothing sound, making it a memorable gift for any special occasion🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Wind Chimes With Glass Ornament And Crystal Charm

 

PRODUCTION

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
